newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Network Entertainment says Hewson resigns.
newsitem.headline: Network Entertainment says Hewson resigns.

text.p: Video distributor Network Entertainment Group Ltd said on Monday it had appointed Gary Garton as non-executive chairman, replacing John Hewson who has resigned.
Garton was the managing director of Aristocrat Leisure Ltd until November last year.
Hewson was the leader of the Federal Opposition in parliament until soon after he lost the 1993 election.

Network Entertainment said Hewson and fellow director Carmel Travers had resigned, effective Monday, due to differing views with management and other directors about the future development of the company and its operations.
